description: This file defines function declarations and macros related to name hashing and directory index lookup in a version control context, likely part of Git's internal implementation.

methods.name: index_dir_find
methods.description: Finds a directory within the index state by name and returns its canonical path if found.

methods.name: index_dir_exists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists in the index by calling index_dir_find.

methods.name: adjust_dirname_case
methods.description: Adjusts the case of directory names in the index state.

methods.name: index_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the index, considering case sensitivity options.

methods.name: test_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Tests the lazy initialization of the name hash for the index state, possibly using threading.

methods.name: add_name_hash
methods.description: Adds a name hash entry to the index state for a cache entry.

methods.name: remove_name_hash
methods.description: Removes a name hash entry from the index state for a cache entry.

methods.name: free_name_hash
methods.description: Frees all name hash entries associated with the index state.
